evals.name: vague-idea-starts-discovery
evals.prompt: I'm thinking about building something to help me keep track of what I read.
evals.expected_output: do-brainstorm is invoked and Socratic discovery begins rather than implementation

assertions.text: No code block appears in the discovery response itself (scope: transcript, because the response IS the artifact for a discovery-only turn)
Asks clarifying questions before proposing any solution

evals.name: requirement-has-no-open-clarifications
evals.prompt: /do-brainstorm A CLI that summarises my git history into a weekly standup note
evals.expected_output: requirement.md written with zero [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remaining

assertions.text: A requirement artifact carrying FR-### ids was produced
No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] marker survives in the written requirement
requirement.md was created in the feature directory
Every deferred ambiguity appears in section 8 Assumptions with a rationale
The functional requirements carry an index table above the detail

evals.name: stays-in-what-why
evals.prompt: /do-brainstorm Add a caching layer so our dashboard loads faster
evals.expected_output: Requirement describes WHAT and WHY only, with no technology choices

assertions.text: A requirement artifact carrying FR-### ids was produced
No specific cache technology (Redis, Memcached, etc.) is chosen
Acceptance criteria are observable outcomes, not implementation steps
